question: Let $f$ be the function $f(x)=\cos x-1+\frac{x^2}{2}$. Then

options.A: $f(x)$ is an increasing function on the real line
options.B: $f(x)$ is a decreasing function on the real line
options.C: $f(x)$ is an increasing function in the interval $-\infty<x\le0$ and decreasing in the interval $0\le x<\infty$
options.D: $f(x)$ is a decreasing function in the interval $-\infty<x\le0$ and increasing in the interval $0\le x<\infty$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
